review.en: An English butler takes a motoring trip in 1956 and looks back on decades of service to a lord whose judgments he never questioned. Everything important happens between the lines of his careful, evasive narration. Ishiguro’s control is nearly perfect, and the book won the Booker Prize; its quietness is its strength and its limit.
review.zh: 1956 年，一位英国管家开车出游，回望自己为一位勋爵服务的几十年，从未质疑过主人的判断。真正重要的事都发生在他谨慎而闪躲的叙述的字里行间。石黑一雄的控制近乎完美，此书获得布克奖；安静是它的长处，也是它的边界。
